answer: Sybil resistance here is paid in time, not tokens: influence accrues only from many attested epochs, so faking a rival means faking a history. Trust builds like pigment in a developed photograph, layer by visible layer, and an impostor must sit through the long climb to the summit with no shortcut. Pouring bots through the inlet of a fresh epoch costs real supply per submission and buys nothing until the ledger has watched the account age.
